description: Update the MCP server (CF-FLUX-MCP/) and the project documentation to support and explain the new FLUX.2 multi-model API. Extend the `generate-flux-image` MCP tool with optional `model`, `width`, `height` parameters, raise the steps cap to 50, update the test-api.js sanity script, and rewrite the relevant API sections of CF-FLUX-MCP/README.md and the root README.md to describe the new request body shape and model choices.
steps: Edit CF-FLUX-MCP/simple-server-final.js: in the `server.tool('generate-flux-image', ...)` registration extend the input schema with: model (z.enum of the three flux-2 model ids, optional, .describe('Model id; default @cf/black-forest-labs/flux-2-klein-4b')), width (z.number().int().min(256).max(2048).optional().describe('Image width in pixels, multiple of 32, default 1024')), height (same, default 1024), and update steps to z.number().min(1).max(50).optional() with a description noting that klein models support 1-8 and dev supports 1-50. In the tool handler, pass model/width/height through to fluxService.generateImage. In SimpleFluxService.generateImage, accept those optional args, default model to '@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-2-klein-4b', width/height to 1024, and include all four fields (prompt, model, width, height, steps) in the JSON body POSTed to the Worker. Keep the chinese-to-english helper, the saveBase64Image logic, and the worker_url.txt loading unchanged.

Edit CF-FLUX-MCP/test-api.js to send the new fields. Use a small request body with model='@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-2-klein-4b', width=1024, height=1024, steps=4 and prompt='mountain river forest'. Add a second test invocation with model='@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-2-dev', steps=20. The script just logs response status and body; do not add a real test framework.

Update CF-FLUX-MCP/README.md: replace the old API example body with the new shape (prompt + model + width + height + steps), document the three model ids and their step ranges, and update the /generate-flux-image example to include `model='@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-2-klein-4b'`.

Update the root README.md `## API说明` section: replace the example body with `{ "prompt": "...", "model": "@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-2-klein-4b", "width": 1024, "height": 1024, "steps": 4 }`, add a paragraph listing the three available models and their recommended step ranges, and note that all FLUX.2 calls draw from the shared 10,000 Neurons/day Cloudflare free allocation. Also update the Cursor usage section to mention the new optional model/width/height parameters.
Run `node --check CF-FLUX-MCP/simple-server-final.js` and `node --check CF-FLUX-MCP/test-api.js` to confirm no syntax errors.
acceptance_criteria: CF-FLUX-MCP/simple-server-final.js declares model/width/height as optional zod params on the generate-flux-image tool and forwards them in the POST body.
CF-FLUX-MCP/test-api.js sends the new fields and (for the second case) demonstrates flux-2-dev with steps > 8.
CF-FLUX-MCP/README.md and root README.md no longer show `flux-1-schnell` in any code example, and document the three flux-2 model ids with step-range guidance.
`node --check` succeeds on both JS files in CF-FLUX-MCP/.
verification: grep -RIn 'flux-1-schnell' README.md CF-FLUX-MCP/README.md — no matches in code examples (mentions in changelog/migration notes are acceptable)
grep -n 'flux-2-klein-4b\|flux-2-klein-9b\|flux-2-dev' README.md CF-FLUX-MCP/README.md — at least one match per file
findings:
Extended CF-FLUX-MCP and the project READMEs for the FLUX.2 multi-model API.

1) CF-FLUX-MCP/simple-server-final.js: the generate-flux-image tool's zod schema now exposes optional `model` (z.enum of the three flux-2 ids, default-described as @cf/black-forest-labs/flux-2-klein-4b), `width` (z.number().int().min(256).max(2048).optional, described default 1024, multiple of 32), `height` (same), and `steps` widened to z.number().min(1).max(50).optional with a description noting klein supports 1-8 (default 4) and flux-2-dev supports 1-50 (default 25). The tool description now mentions FLUX.2. The handler forwards `params.model/width/height/steps` to fluxService.generateImage. SimpleFluxService.generateImage signature changed to `generateImage(prompt, steps, model, width, height, outputDir, filename)`; it defaults model to '@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-2-klein-4b' and width/height to 1024 when not provided, and includes prompt/model/width/height in the JSON body always; steps is included only when provided so the Worker can fill the per-model default. The chinese-to-english helper, saveBase64Image, and worker_url.txt loading were not modified.

2) CF-FLUX-MCP/test-api.js: rewritten to iterate a TEST_CASES array. Case 1 uses model='@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-2-klein-4b', width=1024, height=1024, steps=4, prompt='mountain river forest'. Case 2 uses model='@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-2-dev', steps=20 (>8, demonstrates the dev model's wider range) with the same prompt and resolution. Each case logs request body, response status/text, and parses JSON when possible. No test framework added.

3) CF-FLUX-MCP/README.md: replaced the old /generate-flux-image example with `prompt=... model="@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-2-klein-4b" width=1024 height=1024 steps=4`. Parameter list expanded to document model (with the three ids and their step ranges), width, height, and the per-model steps semantics, plus output_dir/filename. The example POST body now includes prompt/model/width/height/steps and notes that all three FLUX.2 models share the 10,000 Neurons/day free allocation. Troubleshooting step about `steps` updated to mention klein 1-8 and dev 1-50.

4) Root README.md `## API说明`: example body replaced with `{prompt, model, width, height, steps}`, followed by a bullet list of the three model ids with their recommended step ranges (klein-4b/9b 1-8 default 4; dev 1-50 default 25) and a note that all three FLUX.2 models share Cloudflare Workers AI's 10,000 Neurons/day free allocation. Cursor `/generate-flux-image` example updated to include the new optional `model`/`width`/`height`/`steps` arguments and the parameter list now documents each (with the same per-model step ranges). Troubleshooting bullet about steps updated from '(1-8)' to mention both ranges. No code examples reference flux-1-schnell anymore.

Verification (PATH=/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.22.3/bin:$PATH): `node --check simple-server-final.js` and `node --check test-api.js` both exited 0. `grep -RIn 'flux-1-schnell' README.md CF-FLUX-MCP/README.md` returned no matches. `grep -nE 'flux-2-klein-4b|flux-2-klein-9b|flux-2-dev' README.md CF-FLUX-MCP/README.md` returned multiple matches per file covering all three model ids. No deviations from the spec.
